warning: PLACEHOLDER VOCABULARY. Authored from written descriptions by someone who is not a fluent signer and reviewed by no Deaf signer. Every entry is marked unvalidated. Replace before any of this is presented as ASL.

STAND.description: A V hand stands, fingers down, on the palm of the other hand.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DANCE.description: A V hand swings back and forth over the other palm.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

SING.description: A flat hand sways back and forth over the forearm.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

LISTEN.description: A cupped hand held to the ear.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FEEL.description: The middle finger brushes up the chest.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FORGET.description: A flat hand wipes across the forehead and closes.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DECIDE.description: Both F hands drop from the forehead.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CHOOSE.description: A pinch picks something from the air and lifts it.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FIND.description: An open hand rises, fingers closing into a pinch.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

TRY.description: Both T hands push forward together.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

READ.description: A V hand scans down the face of the other palm.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

WRITE.description: A pinched hand writes across the palm of the other.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

STUDY.description: Fingers wiggle toward the palm of the other hand.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The wiggle is not rendered.
Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

VISIT.description: Two V hands circle forward alternately.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CHANGE.description: Two fists turn over in opposite directions.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BREAK.description: Two fists held together snap apart.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CUT.description: Two fingers snip like scissors, moving forward.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The snip is a change from V to U.

LOSE.description: Pinched fingers drop open, letting something go.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

COOK.description: A flat hand turns over on the palm of the other, as when turning food.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

KITCHEN.description: A K hand turns over on the palm of the other.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MONDAY.description: An M hand makes a small circle, palm out.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

TUESDAY.description: A T hand makes a small circle, palm out.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

WEDNESDAY.description: A W hand makes a small circle, palm out.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FRIDAY.description: An F hand makes a small circle, palm out.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

SATURDAY.description: An S hand makes a small circle, palm out.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

THURSDAY.description: A T hand makes a small circle and finishes as an H.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The T-to-H change is made partway round the circle.

SUNDAY.description: Both open hands, palms out, make a circle outward.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

SUMMER.description: A bent index finger is drawn across the forehead, as if wiping sweat.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Differs from BLACK only in handshape.

WINTER.description: Two W hands held at the chest shiver.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Differs from COLD only in handshape.

MONTH.description: An index finger slides down the other index finger, as down a calendar.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

NOON.description: A flat hand stands upright on the forearm of the other.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

START.description: An index finger twists between the fingers of the other hand.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

LATER.description: An L hand, thumb on the palm, twists forward.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

ALWAYS.description: An index finger circles in front of the body.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BREAD.description: The fingers of one hand slice down the back of the other, as when cutting a loaf.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MILK.description: A hand opens and closes, as when milking.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

COFFEE.description: One fist circles on top of the other, grinding.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MEAT.description: A pinching hand takes hold of the fleshy part of the other hand and shakes it.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CHEESE.description: Two flat hands press together and twist.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

APPLE.description: A bent index finger twists against the cheek.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FRUIT.description: An F hand twists against the cheek.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

VEGETABLE.description: A V hand twists against the cheek.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

THIRSTY.description: An index finger draws down the throat.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DOG.description: A hand pats the thigh, as when calling a dog.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The snap that follows the pat is not rendered.

CAT.description: Two pinched hands at the cheeks draw outward, as whiskers.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BIRD.description: A beak opens and closes at the mouth.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DUCK.description: Fingers open and close at the mouth like a bill.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

HORSE.description: A U hand, thumb at the temple, with the fingers flapping like ears.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

COW.description: A Y hand, thumb at the temple, twists like a horn.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

PIG.description: The back of a hand under the chin, fingers flapping.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MOUSE.description: An index finger brushes up the nose, twice.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

ELEPHANT.description: A hand swings out from the nose like a trunk.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BEAR.description: Both clawed hands scratch down the chest, arms crossed.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Starts with the arms already crossed: mirrored hands cannot cross each other on the way in without passing through.

SNAKE.description: A bent V hand, as fangs, weaves forward.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DEER.description: Both open hands at the temples, as antlers.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FISH.description: A flat hand swims forward, wriggling.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The wriggle is a sway; one sign for the animal and the food.

ANIMAL.description: Both bent hands pat the chest alternately.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

SUN.description: A hand held up and to the side, opening its fingers like rays.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MOON.description: A C hand held up beside the head.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

STAR.description: Two index fingers brush past each other going up, alternately.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

SKY.description: A flat hand sweeps in an arc overhead.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

RAIN.description: Both hands, fingers wiggling, move down like falling rain.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The finger wiggle is not rendered.

SNOW.description: Both hands, fingers fluttering, drift gently down.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The flutter is not rendered.

WIND.description: Both flat hands sway from side to side.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FIRE.description: Both hands, fingers wiggling, rise like flames.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The flicker is not rendered.

TREE.description: An open hand on the forearm, twisting, like a tree on a trunk.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FLOWER.description: A flattened O touches one side of the nose, then the other.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.
Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

WORLD.description: A W hand circles around a fist.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

ROOM.description: Two R hands, palms facing, outline the walls of a room.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Differs from READY only in palm orientation.

DOOR.description: A flat hand swings on the edge of the other, like a door on its hinge.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BED.description: A flat hand against the cheek, as a head on a pillow.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Angled so the thumb clears the head; the head tilt is not rendered.

TABLE.description: A flat hand taps down on the other flat hand, as on a tabletop.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CHAIR.description: A bent V hand taps twice on another, as a seat.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Differs from SIT only in tapping twice.

CHURCH.description: A C hand taps on the back of a fist.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

ROAD.description: Two flat hands, palms facing, move forward together, as the sides of a road.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

THING.description: A flat hand, palm up, moves out to the side.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

PAPER.description: The heel of one hand brushes across the other, twice.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.
Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CLOTHES.description: Both hands brush down the chest.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.
Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

ANSWER.description: Two index fingers move forward from the lips.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

PROBLEM.description: Bent V knuckles twist against each other.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Differs from HARD in twisting rather than tapping.

IDEA.description: An I hand rises from the forehead.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

LIFE.description: Both L hands move up the body.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. The same movement as LIVE with an L handshape.

GOD.description: A flat hand starts above the head and lowers.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

LAW.description: An L hand taps on the palm of the other hand.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

TRAIN.description: Two fingers slide along two fingers, as a train on its track.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BIKE.description: Two fists pedal in alternating circles.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MANY.description: Both fists spring open, again and again.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

MUCH.description: Both hands, curved, draw apart as if around something large.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

NOTHING.description: Both O hands open and move apart.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

ANOTHER.description: A thumb, held out, swings to the side.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.
Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DONT_KNOW.description: A flat hand at the forehead turns outward and away.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.
Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

LIBRARY.description: An L hand makes a small circle, palm out.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FAT.description: Both cupped hands at the cheeks move outward, as puffed cheeks.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

UP.description: An index finger points up and rises.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

DOWN.description: An index finger points down and lowers.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

LEFT.description: An L hand, thumb out, moves toward the left.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

HERE.description: Both flat hands, palms up, make small circles in front of the body.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

CHRISTMAS.description: A C hand sweeps in an arc across the chest.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

BORN.description: Both flat hands, palms up, move out from the stomach.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer. Differs from PREGNANT in orientation and in using both hands.

JUMP.description: A V hand hops up off the palm of the other hand and lands again.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.

FALL.description: A V hand standing on the palm of the other tips over.

provenance.note: Authored from a written description; not reviewed by a Deaf signer.
